dataset.title: Hyderabad Metro Stations — Public Reference Dataset
dataset.description: A JSON dataset of Hyderabad Metro station names and associated line labels, compiled as a convenient dashboard starter from publicly accessible Hyderabad open-GIS/transit references. It is not a real-time service feed.

source.name: Lakeer-org Hyderabad Open GIS Data
source.related_public_dataset: Hyderabad metro stations GeoJSON in the repository's Public Transport/Stops data

limitations: This file contains station names and broad line labels, not ridership counts, ticket prices, service frequency, or real-time arrival data.
No latitude/longitude values are included because they were not independently verified for this generated file.
Check the source and Hyderabad Metro Rail for current line/operational details before using this for transport decisions.
This is not the original Blackcoffer dataset and does not contain Blackcoffer intensity, likelihood, relevance, sector, topic, or PESTLE metrics.
